def main():
    white, black = map(int, input().split())
    sum_needed = white + black
    str_S = 'wbwbwwbwbwbw'
    S_list = list(str_S)
    S_list_sum = len(S_list)

    while sum_needed > S_list_sum:
        S_list.extend(str_S)
        S_list_sum += len(str_S)

    for x in range(S_list_sum - sum_needed + 1):
        part_list = S_list[x:x + sum_needed]
        white_count = part_list.count('w')
        black_count = part_list.count('b')

        if white_count == white and black_count == black:
            print('Yes')
            return

    print('No')
